'''Uniformal Attire''' was a company that operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It specialized in selling corporate uniforms.

==History==
Uniformal Attire was based in the city of [[Hedrett]] on the planet Cularin and the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Mambo Farls]] and the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Mourne Blee]] both worked for it as designers. In about [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], Uniformal Attire was hired by the pharmaceutical company [[Culpharm]] to develop a new uniform for Culpharm's security guards. Farls developed the new uniform, which was very distinct, as it was green and gold, with a multi-colored jacket. However, Farls' wife, [[Gelly Farls]], took some of the uniforms and gave them to her employer, [[Biotherapy]], who used them for industrial espionage.
